intervals.note: No fetched source gives CENPA's founding date. Start is approximated to 2017 (the earliest year for which this session found direct evidence CENPA was hosting ADMX, per the CENPA page's own 'new record ... with its new results from 2017'), used as a conservative lower bound for this open-ended 'active' interval, not a claimed founding date. VERIFIER FIX (2026-09-17): the previous start:null/end:null interval covered no date under A3 (a null start covers only [lo(end),hi(end)], and end was also null), so the entity's derived state at the build date was None while status said 'active' (validator error status-not-derived-state); this bound resolves that.
intervals.quote: ADMX set a new record as the first ever axion experiment to reach the DFSZ sensitivity with its new results from 2017

website.quote: Center for Experimental Nuclear Physics and Astrophysics

name: Center for Experimental Nuclear Physics and Astrophysics (CENPA)
notes: No founding/establishment date for CENPA itself was sourced this session; only its current hosting of ADMX is sourced.

The commonly cited history that ADMX was built at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in 1995 and moved to CENPA in 2010 is reported by Wikipedia without a checkable primary citation; it is NOT recorded as a dated interval here per A17 (no fact from memory / no Wikipedia-only critical dates). Left as an open item in the worklog for a future session to source primarily.

operator_text.quote: Center for Experimental Nuclear Physics and Astrophysics, University of Washington, 4311 Mason Place NE, Seattle, WA 98195, USA

summary.plain: CENPA is a physics research lab at the University of Washington in Seattle. It hosts ADMX, an experiment that searches for a hypothetical dark-matter particle called the axion using a large magnet and a supercooled resonant cavity.
summary.technical: University of Washington research laboratory (North Physics Lab building, 4311 Mason Place NE, Seattle) hosting nuclear/astro-particle experiments including the Gen 2 Axion Dark Matter eXperiment (ADMX), which moved to CENPA from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.
